description: get_sold_comps for a list of items in one call. Each query is either a string ('2015 Ford F-150') or an object with its own q/category/country/state. Each item costs one valuation lookup, exactly as if sent alone; an item that comes back without a range is not charged. If the monthly allowance runs out part-way, the items already priced are returned and `batch.truncated` names the rest. Batch size is capped by plan (10 on the free allowance).

state.description: Default 2-letter state/region code for every query.

name: get_sold_comps_batch
title: Sold-price comps, many at once
